facts.fact: Adam 上交佩剑（turned in his sword）后，他对 Guardians 网络和 Rogue Community College 图书馆的访问权限被切断了。
facts.anchor: his access to the Guardians’ network and the library at Rogue Community College had been cut off when he’d turned in his sword.

facts.fact: 演唱会上那个（由跌撞上台而死者）释放出的生物，杀死了 Cathedra 并让观众陷入昏睡，其中一些人还没醒来。
facts.anchor: unleashing a creature that had killed Cathedra and put the crowd to sleep, some of whom weren’t waking up.

facts.fact: Adam 梦见 Ian 时尤其会听到 Between 之歌——Ian 终将坠入该处受困，除非 Adam 找到阻止的办法。
facts.anchor: especially when he dreamed of Ian, who’d eventually fall there and be trapped, unless Adam found a way to stop it.

facts.fact: Adam 与 Jesse 有约在先：他只有通过这门课（passed the class）才能拿到学费补偿。
facts.anchor: His agreement with Jesse was that he only got compensated for the tuition if he passed the class.

facts.fact: 通过邮件链接与 app 聊天后，Adam 确定对方就是 Jack——还有谁会打出「*sigh*」？
facts.anchor: At least Adam was now certain it was Jack. Who else would type *sigh*?

facts.fact: Jack 答应把（boggins）案卷翻译后发给 Adam，但叮嘱不能让人知道是从他那里拿的。
facts.anchor: I’ll translate them and send them over, but you didn’t get them from me.

facts.fact: Cole、Tristan 和其他人可能还活着，但他们的时间不多了。
facts.anchor: They might be alive, but Cole, Tristan, and the others didn’t have forever.

facts.fact: Adam 向 Wendy 与 Joey 打听是否有人在卖灵魂：六个（Six）凡人昏迷躺在医院里。
facts.anchor: Souls. Six humans are lying in the hospital, unconscious. I want to know if anyone’s selling.
